metadata.title: Digital Media: Platforms, Content, and Attention - Landscape

sections.text: **The organizing principle of digital media**: attention is the scarce resource. Everything — platform design, feed algorithms, dark patterns, virality mechanics, content optimization — is structured around the capture and monetization of human attention. Understanding this model is prerequisite to understanding everything else in this directory.
